name: nature-flow
vibe: A calm, living-ecosystem film for wellness, eco and organic brands. A deep-organic forest-dark ground carries a soft flowing mesh gradient, two slow drifting glow-waves, a hazy sun with light rays, gently falling leaves and petals, a water-ripple base with widening rings and a soft vignette that all breathe unbroken across every cut. Serif headlines settle and bloom (the last word in italic leaf-green); real screenshots rest inside soft-rounded leaf-shaped frames; soft feature chips rise and drift; a petal CTA closes. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole ecosystem — the flowing gradient, the glow-waves, the leaves, the frames, the chips and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for wellness, sustainability, nature, skincare, food, mindfulness and any product that should feel calm, organic and alive.
